data.one_liner: High-performance markdown renderer and editor with syntax highlighting, LaTeX, tables, SVG, Mermaid, and real-time streaming.
data.what_it_does: It renders markdown to Flutter widgets with advanced features such as syntax highlighting, LaTeX math, tables, footnotes, SVG images, and Mermaid diagrams. It also provides a fully featured editor with formatting toolbar, slash commands, wikilinks, and real-time streaming support.
use_when: You need a fast, feature-rich markdown renderer for a Flutter app
You want an integrated editor for markdown with live preview
You require LaTeX math or Mermaid diagram support in markdown
You need real-time streaming of markdown content
avoid_when: You only need simple static markdown rendering
Your app has strict bundle size constraints
You are building a minimal UI without editing capabilities
strengths: Rich feature set (syntax highlighting, LaTeX, Mermaid, SVG, tables)
Extensible editor with toolbar and keyboard shortcuts
weaknesses: Large dependency footprint (flutter_highlight, flutter_math_fork, flutter_svg, cached_network_image)
Complex feature set may be overkill for simple use cases
data.setup_notes: Add dependency in pubspec, import package, no build_runner needed
